method: AI-assisted inspection of relevant upstream production diffs for all sixteen historically selected rows, with selected tests and first-parent source checks. No new detector scan or independent human adjudication.

status_definitions.supported: Concrete broader failure-routing example supported by source; not membership in a uniform confirmed-defect population.
status_definitions.excluded: Language-excluded or adjacent hazard, not an in-scope silent-success example.
status_definitions.uncertain: Construct boundary unresolved; do not force a confirmed-defect classification.
status_definitions.location-only: Historical warning proximity does not establish detection of the repaired semantic defect.

historical_matching_limitation: The historical driver derives candidate sites from removed Python lines. Additive changes can be omitted; proximity to changed lines does not prove semantic detection.

records.rationale: Exhausted retries leave NaN scores; the fix warns and uses NaN-aware aggregation. NaN is distinguishable from finite success, so this is a broader sentinel-propagation example.
records.figure_summary: Retry NaNs reach aggregates; fix warns and uses NaN-aware reductions.

records.rationale: The handler already warns, then sets exists=True and continues. Raising AzureAuthError repairs failure-to-continuation; this is not silently unlogged and not established as a missing local-handler shape.
records.figure_summary: Warning already exists; failure still becomes exists=True and continuation.

records.rationale: Failed-judge NaNs contaminate panel aggregates; the fix warns and uses NaN-aware reductions. Supported broader propagation case, not literal indistinguishable finite success.
records.figure_summary: Failed-judge NaNs poison aggregates; fix warns and excludes them.

records.rationale: Selected techniques without registered factories were silently filtered. The fix explicitly rejects missing factories.
records.figure_summary: Missing factories silently filter selected techniques; fix raises.

records.rationale: Failure becomes an auth-disabled configuration, but the relevant implementation is TypeScript; excluded from Python detector evaluation.
records.figure_summary: Error becomes auth-disabled configuration; TypeScript, outside language scope.

records.rationale: Retry failures are discarded before empty responses emerge on exhaustion. The historical no-action warning is causally relevant; the fix preserves alignment through placeholders.
records.figure_summary: Discarded retry errors lead to empty output; local warning is relevant.

records.rationale: Adding Tenacity reraise=True preserves the underlying error instead of RetryError. Failure already propagates; this is adjacent exception wrapping, not silent success or a local-handler gap.
records.figure_summary: RetryError becomes the underlying exception; failure already propagates.

records.rationale: Missing issue_id produced a numeric Score(0.0); the fix raises. The answer field already contains diagnostic information, so do not claim complete absence of a signal.
records.figure_summary: Missing issue_id becomes score zero, with an answer-field diagnostic.

records.rationale: errors=ignore discarded undecodable bytes from file-like input. Strict decoding and charset fallback replace this non-handler suppression.
records.figure_summary: errors=ignore drops undecodable bytes; fix adds strict decoding and fallback.

records.rationale: Unknown characters were dropped and are now preserved. Data loss is established; classifying unsupported input as an operational failure rather than an ordinary transform bug needs a uniform construct criterion.
records.figure_summary: Unknown characters are dropped; operational-failure membership is uncertain.

records.rationale: Range checks and failure-sentinel preservation repair the defect. The credited except/pass site changes to continue with the same skipping behaviour. Co-location does not establish semantic detection.
records.figure_summary: Local pass-to-continue match does not identify the repaired range validation.

records.rationale: Pre-fix division propagates ZeroDivisionError; the fix introduces a uniform fallback. This is a crash repair, not removal of pre-existing failure-to-success routing.
records.figure_summary: Division originally crashes; the patch introduces a uniform fallback.

records.rationale: Missing logprob yields implicit None, then a downstream numeric TypeError; the fix uses NaN. Contract mismatch is supported, but success laundering is not established. Pure-additive/non-handler location is not a sufficient exclusion criterion.
records.figure_summary: Implicit None later raises TypeError; success laundering is unestablished.

records.rationale: A write failure already prints to stderr, but callers still claim successful writing. Returning a boolean and guarding success claims repairs cross-function outcome contradiction.
records.figure_summary: Error is printed, then callers claim success; fix guards those claims.

records.rationale: Unreadable files and malformed JSON lines are silently skipped; the fix records unscannable input. The historical OSError/return match is relevant; the continue case remains unmatched.
records.figure_summary: Unreadable input is silently skipped; local OSError/return warning is relevant.

records.rationale: Malformed multi-letter grades were reduced to a plausible first-letter grade. The fix validates accepted forms and rejects the rest.
records.figure_summary: Malformed grades become plausible first-letter grades; fix validates input.
